svg.title: Room booking card: widen the view to restore the enclosure cue
svg.desc: Only the image-window viewBox changes from x200/y100/960×640 to full1536×1024 source. Same480×320 frame, source photograph, copy, typography, colors, paper and lighting. Widening restores the closed door and more room context; it does not establish acoustic privacy. Source inset marks before dashed and after solid. Fictional example. Reused generated photograph; native typography and crop windows.
svg.text: BEFORE · A tight crop omits the door
AFTER · A wider crop restores useful context
Same source · Only the crop window changes
